group-2024-jslk-seven-choices.overview: 本文围绕新跑者常见错误展开，先总述跑步容易入门但常见错误会影响训练或导致受伤，再依次说明循序渐进、安排休息、穿戴合适装备和不要带痛硬跑等建议。

discourseStructure.summary: 全文采用“总起提醒 + 四个错误小标题”的结构。七选五空位既包括引入读者对象的段中承启句，也包括段末具体建议、小标题主旨句和段首承接句。

units.heading: Common Mistakes New Runners Make
units.summary: 总述跑步适合大众，但新跑者常见错误会妨碍训练或导致受伤，引出后文建议。

units.heading: Doing too much too soon
units.summary: 说明新跑者容易训练过量，应逐步增加训练量以降低受伤风险。

units.heading: Not taking rest days
units.summary: 说明每天跑步并不合适，跑步冲击大，身体需要在训练间休息。

units.heading: Not wearing the right equipment
units.summary: 说明虽然跑步不一定需要昂贵装备，但应穿戴合适，尤其要选好跑鞋。

units.heading: Running through pain
units.summary: 说明跑步有时不舒服，但真正疼痛时应停下处理并倾听身体。

topicClues: Running is a great way to get in shape
many make a number of common mistakes

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: However,many make a number of common mistakes,which can interfere(妨碍)with training or lead to injury.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: keep these things in mind to help you increase your chances of running success.

matchedClues.relation: 语义对应：刚开始跑步的人就是 new runners。
语法衔接：If 从句接空后祈使句，形成条件建议。

optionFit.fitSummary: 36 空的核心是补出“如果你刚开始跑步”这个条件，把标题中的新跑者和空后的建议句连接起来。

keyDistractors.reason: running 与全文主题一致。；它不能和空后的 keep these things in mind 构成自然的条件建议结构。
像是常见错误的一类。；本段还没有进入具体错误列表，且空后需要条件从句而不是名词短语标题。

q-2024-jslk-036.teachingNote: 看到空后是逗号加祈使句时，优先检查选项中是否有 If / While 等从属连词；再用标题 New Runners 锁定目标读者。

mechanismSignals.relation: If 引出适用对象，与空后 keep these things in mind 构成条件—建议关系。

topicClues: Slowly easing into a training program

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Slowly easing into a training program will help reduce the risk of injury,so you can continue on with your new running routine.

optionFit.correctOptionText: Experts suggest increasing your running distance by no more than 10%each week

matchedClues.optionSide: increasing your running distance by no more than 10%each week
matchedClues.relation: 反向对应：不要过快增加跑量。

matchedClues.contextSide: Slowly easing into a training program
matchedClues.relation: 具体化：用 10% 规则说明 slowly easing。

optionFit.fitSummary: 37 空位于段末，正确项把“不要一下做太多”落实为每周跑量增加不超过 10% 的具体规则。

keyDistractors.reason: 也含有 It’s important，像建议句。；same muscles 讨论的是肌肉使用，不对应本段的跑量、速度和循序渐进。
也是新跑者的常见错误。；它更适合作为下一段的标题，不能总结本段“too much too soon”。

q-2024-jslk-037.teachingNote: 段末空常考“总结或具体化”。先看小标题 Doing too much too soon，再找选项中能把 too much/soon 量化为训练规则的句子。

topicClues: run every day(or nearly every day)
give your body a rest between workouts

contextEvidence.afterQuote: So it’s important to give your body a rest between workouts.

matchedClues.contextSide: run every day(or nearly every day)
matchedClues.relation: 语义对应：每天跑就是没有休息日。

matchedClues.contextSide: give your body a rest between workouts
matchedClues.relation: 词汇复现：rest 是本段核心词。

optionFit.fitSummary: 38 空是小标题，要概括下文“不要每天跑，要在训练之间休息”，所以选 A。

keyDistractors.reason: 它也以 It’s important 开头，和下文句式相似。；本段重点是休息日，不是同一肌肉的重复使用。
同样是训练建议。；G 讲跑量递增，属于上一段 Doing too much too soon 的内容。

q-2024-jslk-038.teachingNote: 标题空要向下看整段，尤其看 but/so 后的结论句；本段结论词是 rest，不要被泛泛的训练建议带偏。

topicClues: a good pair of running shoes

contextEvidence.afterQuote: The most important piece of equipment for running is a good pair of running shoes,so be sure to do some research before you purchase a pair.

optionFit.correctOptionText: While it may be true that you don’t need expensive equipment to take up running

matchedClues.contextSide: it’s important that you wear properly for your workouts
matchedClues.relation: 逻辑衔接：While 让步从句与空后主句构成完整句。

matchedClues.contextSide: right equipment / piece of equipment / running shoes
matchedClues.relation: 话题复现：equipment 与本段装备主题一致。

optionFit.fitSummary: 39 空的关键是语法和话题双锁定：F 的 While 从句能接空后的 it’s important that，同时 equipment 对应本段装备主题。

keyDistractors.reason: 也能与 it’s important 形成表面重复。；空后已经有 it’s important that，放入 E 会造成句法冲突，并且 same muscles 不属于装备话题。
Running 与 workouts 有关联。；它不能和空后的逗号及 it’s important that 构成自然句法，也不对应 equipment。

q-2024-jslk-039.teachingNote: 遇到空后逗号加完整主句时，要优先检查从属连词；本题 While 与 it’s important that 构成让步转折，是比单纯词汇复现更强的证据。

mechanismSignals.targetText: it’s important that you wear properly for your workouts
mechanismSignals.relation: While 引出让步，和空后 it’s important that 形成“虽然不一定昂贵，但仍要穿戴合适”的让步—转折关系。

contextEvidence.afterQuote: Remember:It doesn’t make you less of a runner if you listen to your body to keep it healthy.

optionFit.correctOptionText: Running can be uncomfortable at times

matchedClues.relation: 近义衔接：uncomfortable 概括下文 hurts/pain。
话题复现：Running 承接小标题中的跑步主题。

optionFit.fitSummary: 40 空用一般性的“跑步有时会不舒服”引出下句“如果疼就停下来处理”，形成从总说到具体处理的衔接。

keyDistractors.reason: 新跑者主题贯穿全文。；它是条件从句，不能单独放在句号前，也不直接回应 pain/hurts。
似乎也和身体有关。；same muscles 不对应本段的 pain、hurts 和 stop and treat the pain。

q-2024-jslk-040.teachingNote: 段首句常先概括，再由下一句具体展开。这里用 uncomfortable 概括 hurts/pain，不要把“身体相关”的选项都当成正确项。

mechanismSignals.relation: uncomfortable 与空后 hurts、pain 构成疼痛/不适话题的词汇呼应。
